checked_profile.summary: The Laurel Road refinancing link now leads to KeyBank. This profile follows the current destination and its disclosures.
checked_profile.scope: The former Laurel Road product URL redirected to KeyBank when checked. Facts below describe that destination’s current refinance disclosures, not the terms of an existing Laurel Road account.

facts.label: Current destination
facts.text: Laurel Road’s student refinance URL redirects to KeyBank’s student loan refinancing page. Existing borrowers should use the servicer identified on their own statement.

facts.label: Fees
facts.text: KeyBank lists no origination fee or prepayment penalty. A payment over 15 days late may incur a fee capped at the lesser of 5% of the late payment or $28. A payment returned for insufficient funds or a closed account may cost $20.

facts.label: Credit-check stages
facts.text: Preliminary rates follow a soft credit check and can change. Completing the application requires supporting documents and a hard credit check; final terms depend on underwriting approval.

questions: Does this KeyBank program cover my degree, employment status and existing loans?
Who will service the new loan, and how does that differ from my current account?
What are the final APR, payment schedule and conditions for any discount?
